items.title: The Ink Tools shared folder in .data/plugin/, where every Ink Tools plugin reads and writes the values the tools share
items.reason: the SDK has no store shared between plugins; the hidden .data/plugin/ is the folder the plugin file guard lets each plugin with the file permissions write, and Supernote Cloud does not sync it

evidence.source: device round on a Manta: two plugins with different plugin ids created, wrote, read and listed the folder (#499)
